purpose: Overlap classification of active scientific repositories by load-bearing evidence/inference mode. Membership is not exclusive and is not a prestige or evidence-strength score.

theory_simulation.label: 数理・シミュレーション
theory_simulation.definition: Formal theorem, exact construction, controlled synthetic/finite simulation, or known-truth model evidence is load-bearing for the current scientific claim. The strict 'no real data' region is the portion of T that does not overlap public_data or own_new_data.

methods.label: 方法
methods.definition: A reusable measurement, inference, forecasting, identification, observation-design, survey-design or data-contract method is a primary scientific object.

public_data.label: 公開データ / メタ・統合
public_data.definition: Third-party public archives, published source-adjudicated evidence, public biodiversity/sensor datasets or literature-derived comparative data are load-bearing in a current empirical lane or synthesis. This category is broader than classical meta-analysis.

own_new_data.label: 自分・新規データ実証
own_new_data.definition: Current or explicitly prospective primary empirical closure requires researcher-generated field, specimen, genomic, laboratory, intervention or physical sensor data. It includes already-collected own material and frozen future collection designs.

Formal architecture theory and robustness are load-bearing; the empirical mechanism layer is a source-adjudicated public literature synthesis.
Macroecological island analysis is built from opportunistic/public flora, occurrence and trait evidence across a large island universe.
General observation-design method with a controlled truth-known benchmark; no natural dataset is required for the core method claim.
A reusable field-observation system whose scientific validation and use require newly recorded physical flower-visitor data.
Synthetic causal-diagnostic theory/method exists, while the active V13 mainline requires a blinded new physical camera experiment.
Reusable survey-prioritization method validated prospectively on public occurrence/environment data; it does not require own biological data for the current paper.
Theorem-guided finite eco-genetic model and locked simulations carry the scientific claims; natural systems are not validation data.
Finite exact theory of future/composition insufficiency; current claims are mathematical/constructive rather than empirical.
Synthetic conditional-response geometry is load-bearing and is triangulated against a source-locked public Izu empirical dataset.
The active relational-state/warning flagship is carried by exact finite-model results and prospectively locked simulations; natural systems are ecological projection, not validation.
Finite semantic/history transport theory with deterministic witnesses; no natural dataset is required for the theorem core.
Theorem-first evidence/reportability method with exact finite or risk-limited guarantees; it is both theory and methodological design.
Finite retained-mechanism response theory; current results are exact/constructive rather than natural-data empirical claims.
Focal empirical pipeline is based on the researcher's specimen scans, annotations and field provenance from Izu plants.
Both active lanes are analyses of public/community photographs, literature-derived trait cases, GBIF and climate products.
General world-set reconstruction/forecast method plus prospectively gated validation on public heterogeneous ecological datasets.
Information-theoretic/methodological niche-state framework with public Movebank/Snapshot Serengeti/BOP_RODENT empirical endpoints.
Evolutionary-history paper integrates public phylogenies, trait reconstructions, chronology and historical-environment sources.
Cross-clade flower-colour evolutionary programme is built from published molecular/trait evidence and source bundles.
Leakage-free SDM methodology is validated in known-truth simulations and a frozen fresh public-plant-data lane.
Exact finite contract-relative ecological state theory and constructive scaling results; no natural-data validation is required for the theorem.
Meta-theory and formal portfolio/admission grammar; empirical examples are typed projections rather than load-bearing natural data.
Process-preserving observation method is supported by a large synthetic closed-world surface and known-truth information-preservation tests.
The chapter is explicitly an own-data discrimination programme; same-individual ancestry, phenotype and cytotype data are still required.
Formal compromise geometry is paired with a public literature evidence spine, but decisive causal closure requires a new matched manipulation experiment.
General mechanistic-identification theory/method; current headline is structural identification rather than a public-data empirical synthesis.
Current H1-H5 method paper uses external/public camera-trap and acoustic data, while the open H6 route requires new same-system PolliPi data.
Reusable four-gate empirical-method synthesis over multiple locked public natural datasets; no own-data experiment is required for its current paper.
Formal middle-world theory uses a published Peucedanum anchor, while direct middle-world promotion requires new matched architecture/fitness data.
General reference-guided set-refinement theory and reusable observation method migrated from PolliPi; physical-reference informativeness remains external validation.
Analytic evolutionary-game layer over SCH/BALANCE/BITA with replicator, invasion and network results; no real dataset is required for the current core.

interpretation_rules: Memberships describe the evidence/inference mode that carries or is required to close a repository's current scientific claim; background citations alone do not create membership.
A repository can occupy multiple sets. For example, a theory-method paper tested on public data is T∩M∩P rather than being forced into one class.
The Venn/variance-partitioning geometry on the homepage is schematic; the exact intersection cards and this JSON are authoritative.
The theory_simulation set includes hybrid repos. 'Theory/simulation without real data' is specifically the T-only and T∩M regions that do not overlap P or O.
Public-data membership does not mean every file is public or that all analyses are meta-analyses; it means public/third-party evidence is load-bearing for a current lane.
Own/new-data membership does not imply that data have already been collected; it includes predeclared empirical programmes whose claim cannot close without new researcher-generated data.
Category overlap does not transfer claim ownership between repositories.
